name: Tamasha
description: Tamasha is Pakistan's boldest celebrity reality show, where drama, strategy, and raw emotions collide inside a sealed house. A group of diverse celebrities from across the entertainment world live together for weeks-completely cut off from the outside world. Under constant surveillance, they face daily challenges, personal conflicts, and power struggles. As alliances shift and secrets unravel, only one housemate can survive the drama to claim the ultimate title. In this house, every move is a performance-and every moment is Tamasha.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Tamasha Season 4 begins with a grand home tour, giving viewers a glimpse into the stunning new house where the drama will unfold. Contestants are introduced, each with their own game plan, before the powerful Wazir role is revealed, shaking up the competition. Tensions mount as the first round of nominations sets the stage for alliances and rivalries to form.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Participants face conflicts over food distribution, time management, and cooperation. Some struggle with limited resources, while others debate ethical practices (e.g., sharing food).

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Tasks include cooking meals and physical challenges, with limited resources like microwaves. Voting determines eliminations using veto cards.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Breaking rules results in penalties, such as disqualification or a "jail" period (e.g., 1 hour of isolation). Contestants argue about the fairness of these penalties, with some claiming they are overly harsh.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Tensions boil as Wazeer sends contestants to jail. Food trades through cards spark chaos. Clashes erupt, rules are broken, emotions overflow into tears. Just then, the host delivers a shocking, dangerous announcement targeting the Wazeer.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Frustration explodes as contestants lash out at Wazeer. Conflicts intensify. Amid tension, 14 August is celebrated. Thirteen enter the danger zone—some inactive, some spared. Wazeer is replaced. Teams reshuffle. A new game fuels rising tensions.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Chaos brews at the breakfast table as conflicts erupt. Wazeer scolds the house for delayed duties. A new game with strict rules is announced. Victories cheer some, defeats sting others. Tensions ease as few apologize.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Happiness clashes with Wazeer’s punishments. The host scolds sharply. Two contestants face emotional elimination. Conflicts flare over trivial matters—tears and insults erupt. Teams compete fiercely, then decide food supplies. Tension simmers beneath the surface.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: A new Wazeer takes charge and appoints a Musheer. Misbehavior lands some contestants in jail. The host introduces a rule-bound team game. Rivalries ignite. As the day ends, chaos and tension grip the Tamasha house.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Wazeer faces growing hatred from contestants. Rules shatter, insults fly. A gripping game begins—to uncover the traitor. Another intense challenge follows—some win, some are saved, others fail. But the hunt for the traitor continues...

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Wazeer assigns new duties, but minor issues spark major conflicts. Tension peaks as traitors are finally revealed—some land in the danger zone, a few are saved. A high-stakes game decides the fate of the rest.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: A new day erupts with conflict over breakfast. Tensions spiral out of control. Seven contestants battle in a survival game. Post-game fights break out. The host punishes mockery—sending contestants behind bars.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Though duties are completed, tensions refuse to settle. A contestant is punished for singing the wrong song. The host shares an emotional life story. A new game begins—teams are divided, and rivalries intensify once more.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Contestants play subtly, hiding strategies beneath calm faces. Five battle in a high-stakes game to escape the danger zone. Some succeed, others fall short. Tension builds—elimination looms tomorrow, and no one feels truly safe.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: The host announces a shocking elimination, leaving emotions raw. Food supplies are confiscated, stunning the house. A new Wazeer takes charge. A fresh game begins with strict rules—who will win the luxury dinner this week?

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Day and night bring nonstop conflict as tensions escalate between contestants. Arguments explode, alliances crack. Wazeer punishes one with six hours in jail. A new team-based game begins—rivalries sharpen, and the pressure intensifies once again.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Wazeer jails one contestant, then another, escalating tension. The house sleeps late, unrest brewing. By morning, a third is jailed. The host scolds Wazeer’s soft approach and the house’s laziness. A new game sparks yet another explosive clash.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Chaos erupts at the breakfast table, followed by a fierce clash in the makeup room. The host arrives, assigning strict duties to the Wazeer. A twist in the saving game sparks betrayal—contestants turn against each other.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Contestants break the eating rule, triggering chaos. Frustration with the Wazeer rises as the host scolds his poor leadership. A new game sparks massive fights. The host steps in, disqualifying several—but one escapes elimination.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: The stolen eggs scandal gets exposed, shocking the house. The host assigns a new challenge—the Bell Game. Tensions explode as contestants clash fiercely, turning the task into utter chaos. Trust shatters, and alliances begin to crumble.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: The group fractures after a fierce fight. The host shocks everyone, announcing there are no rules—contestants must play their own way. Amid the chaos, an emergency strikes one contestant. The intense game begins, raising stakes even higher.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: A new morning sparks fresh fights over trivial issues. The host arrives with shocking news—two contestants face elimination. Amid the tension, the Wazeer loses his position, and a new leader is unexpectedly chosen. Suspense soars.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: The host announces a new game—seemingly easy but deceptively tough. Suddenly, an eliminated contestant returns, shaking the house to its core. Friendships shatter as betrayal spreads, turning alliances into fragile, dangerous webs of suspicion.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: One contestant faces 12 hours in jail but cleverly escapes. Breakfast erupts into fights. The host meets the Wazeer, advising her and others, then assigns a tough new task. The next game brings even greater challenges and tension.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Senseless fights erupt among contestants, escalating chaos. A shocking twist arrives with the unexpected return of a contestant. The new game intensifies rivalries, pushing alliances to the brink—while only one contestant earns the elusive safety this round.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: A new morning brings fresh chaos. The host arrives with a shocking twist. The Wazeer receives stern advice again. Some contestants are saved, others remain jailed. The new game begins, sparking intense fights and rising tensions.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: The Wazeer struggles to control the contestants’ chaos. The host introduces a new game, where only one is saved. Tensions boil over at the dinner table, igniting fierce fights that threaten to unravel alliances.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: A new morning dawns, bringing fresh chaos as contestants suffer under the Wazeer’s mismanagement. The host arrives with a thrilling new game, unveiling an unexpected twist that threatens to upend alliances and ignite fierce rivalries.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: A new morning brings shocking eliminations. The host introduces a high-stakes game to choose the new Wazeer, filled with unexpected dangers and challenges. Contestants face mounting pressure as alliances shift and survival hangs by a thread.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: The new Wazeer is announced. The host scolds contestants for neglecting duties. The Wazeer sends one contestant to jail. A chaotic new game unfolds, while a secret hidden by one contestant threatens to unravel everything.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: The Wazeer assigns duties, but tensions rise as the host’s game forces contestants to critique the Wazeer’s laws. The new challenge ignites fierce conflicts, alliances crack, and the battle for control spirals into unpredictable chaos.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: The game continues smoothly, duties completed on time. The Wazeer sends a few contestants to jail. The host arrives, exposing a hidden item scandal. Some are saved, and a surprise guest shares game-changing tips and tricks.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: The Wazeer orders everyone to follow his commands, but rebellion erupts as contestants refuse, sparking intense fights. Several are jailed. The host arrives, giving the Wazeer strict orders. A new game ignites chaos, clashes, and shocking turns.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: A new morning erupts with fresh fights, tasks, and rising complications, some face jail. As punishment, the Wazeer confiscates makeup, triggering outrage. The host arrives, scolding contestants. A new game begins, unleashing deeper conflicts.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Contestants clash over unfinished duties, tensions boiling over. The host arrives with a shocking new game—this time, contestants get the chance to take revenge. Old grudges resurface, alliances crack, and the game turns dangerously personal.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: The host arrives with a shocking elimination, shaking the house. A high-stakes game is announced to choose the new Wazeer. After the exit, the host tours the house, delivering harsh scoldings and exposing hidden tensions.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: A new morning brings fresh crises. The newly appointed Wazeer assigns tasks, but tension brews. The host arrives with a challenging new game. Chaos erupts as food supplies go missing, sparking fierce fights and rising suspicions.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: The contestants refuse the Wazeer's orders, sparking intense conflict and rising tension. Accusations fly, alliances break, and some face jail. The host arrives, enforcing rules with harsh punishments, restoring order with fear.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Guests arrive, bringing joy and relief to the contestants. But in the kitchen, rules are broken—chaos brews. The host storms in, scolding sharply. A cleaning game begins. Tension rises. Who will be saved now?

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: A new morning brings fresh chaos. Contestants complete their duties, but tension simmers. The host arrives, launching a brutal game of unfiltered words—truths cut deep, sparking fierce conflicts. Another task awaits. Can they win?

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: The host arrives with a twist—it's girls vs boys, igniting chaos and fierce rivalry. Some rise to the challenge, others falter under pressure. Tasks grow tougher. Tension peaks. Which team will triumph in the end?

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Morning brings disorder as duties go undone. The host arrives, furious, scolding the Wazeer for failing his role. Tension lingers until letters from home are delivered. Emotions surge, tears fall. In chaos, a moment of peace.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: The host arrives with a shocking elimination, leaving contestants emotional and tense. But there's no time to grieve—a new game begins to choose the next Wazeer. Strategies unfold. Who will be saved, who will rise?

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: The host appoints a new Wazeer, warning him not to repeat past mistakes. A high-stakes game begins—one contestant can be saved. Tensions flare as some try to save money, others refuse. Chaos and fights erupt.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Discontent brews as several contestants grow frustrated with the Wazeer. The host arrives, unleashing stern warnings over their unruly behavior. Tension spikes as new games begin, rules twist unexpectedly. Survival hangs by a thread. Who gets saved?

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: The makeup room erupts into chaos as the Wazeer clashes with a contestant. Tempers flare. The host storms in, furious—scolding them all and deducting money as punishment. A new task is revealed. Stakes just got higher.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: A special guest arrives, sparking both joy and unexpected chaos among the contestants. The host follows with a dramatic twist—a game of acting begins. Emotions run high, performances clash. Who will impress and be saved?

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: The host arrives, surprising everyone with rare appreciation for the contestants’ performances. A new game begins, high stakes, intense pressure. Audience compliments boost spirits, but tension rises. Only one can be saved. Who will it be?

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: The contestants warmly welcome the special guest—the ex-winner of Tamasha Season 3—whose advice brings joy and motivation. The host arrives with a twist: mimic the guest. Laughter turns tense. Who will shine and be saved?

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: The host arrives with a heavy announcement, two eliminations shake the house. Three contestants are saved. Tension lingers as a new Urdu challenge begins. Minds race. Which team will emerge victorious?

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: A new morning erupts in chaos and fights over delayed duties. The host storms in, furious, scolding contestants and placing them in the danger zone. A crucial game begins, tension thickens. Who will escape elimination’s grip?

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Everyone fulfills their duties, tension briefly easing. But the calm breaks as the host arrives with a fierce new game—demanding sharp minds and unshakable strength. Pressure builds. Who will endure, and who will break?

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: A special cricket guest arrives, sparking joyful chaos and excitement among the contestants. Laughter fills the air. Suddenly, the host appears with serious advice and an unexpected surprise. Hearts race. What twist awaits the house next?

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: The night takes a toll on the contestants—tension, fear, and doubt linger. The host arrives, announcing who has made it to the final week. A dangerous new game begins. Screams echo. Who will survive this fall?

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: The breakfast table sparks explosive new fights. The host arrives, confronting contestants and making them feel the weight of guilt. A new game unfolds as a special guest enters. Tensions explode—will conflict tear them apart?

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: The Wazeer punishes contestants, but many refuse to comply. Suddenly, a special guest arrives with advice and a shocking twist for the survival battle. Just then, the host appears, unveiling a new, brutal game. Who will endure?

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: The kitchen erupts into chaos as no one listens to the Wazeer. The host storms in, announcing eliminations and harshly scolding each contestant for their rude behaviour. Tensions explode. A new, intense game begins. Who will survive?

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: A new morning brings fresh problems as the special guest arrives, stirring chaos and happiness. The host scolds contestants and the strict Wazeer for neglected duties. No game today,tension lingers, yet everyone tries to relax. What’s next?

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: The host arrives early, engaging contestants in deep, personal conversations as they reveal truths about themselves. Suddenly, a special guest enters, bringing comfort, unexpected help, and joining the game. Emotions stir. What twist hides beneath the smiles?

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: A new morning brings fresh tasks and rising pressure. The Wazeer is replaced again by the host’s command. In a rare gesture, the host cooks for the contestants—joy sparks briefly. But the day ends in chaos.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: The host arrives with a tense silence, announcing the next elimination. Shock and sadness flood the room as contestants brace themselves. Emotions run high, but in the heartbreak, they find strength, comforting each other through uncertainty.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Tension rose as contestants whispered endlessly about the looming elimination. Suddenly, the host appeared, eliminating one with chilling finality. Now, only five remain—each with secrets, strategies, and desperation. Who will outlast and win it all?

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: In the gripping Grand Finale, emotions soar as journeys end.
